evc_evh_policy: No EVC/EVH classification thresholds applied. EVC and EVH are preserved as source evidence only. No candidate class or forest-land status is automatically changed based on EVC/EVH.
disturbance_policy: disturbance_status = not_evaluated. No disturbance history, cause, recovery, or previous cover type inferred.
nt_nw_policy: NT and NW are candidate forest land per local scheme. Neither is assigned by this 17-code crosswalk. Do not infer nonstocked forest-land from these source labels or low EVC values.
change_control: Changes require a new crosswalk version file (e.g., mescalero_v1_evt_crosswalk_v2.json). Do not overwrite approved entries.
